propositions: CI ticket-store fetches must apply --filter=blob:none to reduce transfer size from GiB to tens of MiB and time from minutes to seconds across all named-remote and direct-URL checkout paths

actions/checkout@v7 filter input and explicit --filter=blob:none flags must be added while preserving fetch-depth: 0 and existing credential/ref settings in three GitHub workflow files and gerrit-verify direct URL fetches

Production guards must parse git count-objects -v pack size immediately after checkout/materialization and reject fetches exceeding REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB (102400) or REBAR_TICKETS_PACK_LIMIT_KIB (131072) thresholds respectively

Git daemon fixture with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL and uploadpack.allowFilter must validate server capability advertisement and client filter negotiation via GIT_TRACE_PACKET regex matching without hard-coded actor labels

Blobless partial clone must retain complete commit graph for merge-base and era scoping, leave no promisor objects after identity scanning, and preserve all expected events through fetch/merge/push reconvergence with the ours driver
